name: frontier-orchestration
description: Route high-stakes work across frontier models (Claude, Codex, Gemini) with a Jev judge (TypeSafe or OpenJev), a confidence x stakes gate, a different-vendor review rule, and a learning ledger.

interface.shortDescription: Route work across Claude, Codex and Gemini with a Jev judge
interface.longDescription: Discovers which frontier models are reachable, asks Jev (TypeSafe or OpenJev) which model fits each task, gates the pick on confidence x stakes, requires a different-vendor reviewer, and keeps a learning ledger of what worked.
defaultPrompt: Route this estimate review across vendors and tell me which model should review it.
Set up frontier orchestration for this machine.
Run a blind cross-vendor review of this diff.
